quest.title: Cooking Appointment
quest.description: While out on a stroll, you bumped into a strange girl. This girl, a chef from Liyue by the name of Xiangling, is on a journey to seek out exotic ingredients. She enlists your help in a hunt, but your private hunting expedition appears to have earned the ire of Draff, the leader of the hunters. You head off to apologize to him...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x125, Mora x4650, Adventurer's Experience x2, Fine Enhancement Ore x5

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: You must be Xiangling.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Sorry Mr. Draff, this was all my fault.

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: I heard the whole story. And now that you're here in person...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, he's gonna let her have it!

response.speaker: Draff
response.text: ...Please help me promote my meat!

response.speaker: Draff
response.text: Sorry if I was a little brash. Let me explain.

response.speaker: Draff
response.text: Springvale has built its reputation on top-quality meat products, but this reputation is so far limited to Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Draff
response.text: When I heard that the great maestro Xiangling herself was in Mondstadt, I asked Allan to send you over.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Maestro?

response.speaker: Draff
response.text: Haven't you heard? She's the one behind Wanmin Restaurant, that one-of-a-kind folk cuisine restaurant in Liyue Harbor.

response.speaker: Draff
response.text: Her unique take on cooking ingredients is behind some of the best-loved dishes in all of Liyue. They are very highly rated by travelers, too.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Hee-hee, you're too kind. I just try to cook things that are cheap and cheerful.

response.speaker: Draff
response.text: With a top-notch chef cooking top-notch cuisine with top-notch meat from Springvale... Our reputation would spread far and wide.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Hmm... I don't know...

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: I only ever think about how to make tasty dishes... I never limit myself to specific ingredients, and I don't know the first thing about promoting anything.

response.speaker: Draff
response.text: You use boar meat all the time anyway, surely? I can't see what the issue is.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: The issue is... What would you think if I added a bit of Slime Condensate?

response.speaker: Draff
response.text: That's... I mean, couldn't you add something a bit more normal?

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: There's no such thing as "normal" ingredients to me! You can turn anything into a delicacy if you cook it in the right way.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: I will not stand for having my creativity shackled by what ingredients I can and can't use! Food cooked like that is destined to be boring, period!

response.speaker: Draff
response.text: *sigh* Well, since you feel so strongly about it, forget it. But it really is a pity...

choices.text: Celebrity chefs are known to be somewhat strong-minded...
If you're looking for a fight, bring it on!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You know, we did come to apologize... Couldn't you be a little more flexible?

talks.objective: Talk to Xiangling at the source of the aroma

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Hello, may I have a taste of your delicious cooking?

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Sorry, I've taken all the orders I can for the next few days. The earliest I could put you down for is seven days from now, is that okay?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, it must be delicious if it's that popular.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Odd... This woman is clearly a very popular chef...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, good point. Why does Draff want Xiangling to help when Springvale already has this lady?

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Hmm... Maybe he feels that Mondstadt cuisine can't compete with that of Teyvat's biggest business hub, Liyue Harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: But I disagree! I don't think my cooking is at all inferior to anyone else's.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Well then... Show me what you got! Maybe I can give you some feedback.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Sorry, but customer feedback like "Oh, that tasted good" is no use to me. If I wanted feedback I would ask a professional chef— Hang on, are you... Xiangling!?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: That's me!

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: It's really you! Well, I guess you do know what you're doing when it comes to cooking meat then.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: As it happens, I have one of today's prime cuts remaining. So tell me, how would you cook this?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: That depends on the ratio of fat to meat. With this cut, I would probably roast it over a hot stone with a little salt, some Jueyun Chili, and Qingxin flower.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Qingxin flower!? But the melted fat would make the flavor of the flowers ten times stronger than when eaten raw... It would overpower everything!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: I know, that's why it's a garnish — I would never marinate the meat in it!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: I've tried it before. If you baste the petals in oil and then cook them with the right heat and duration, it gets rid of the bitterness completely and leaves you with a lovely crispy topping.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Then throw in some Jueyun Chilis grown at a high altitude, where the low humidity and varying temperature lends them a unique dry heat.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: The petals absorb the saltiness from the sea salt, the chili spice, and the umami of the tender, freshly grilled steak, while also adding a floral aftertaste.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: That's pure overkill! You're going all out on the trimmings and doing no justice to the meat whatsoever.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Who wants to eat a roast when you can taste everything except the roast?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa whoa whoa, stop arguing!

choices.text: I don't think they can hear anyone but themselves...

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Hmph. Well, there's only one sure-fire way out of a cooking dispute...

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: I declare a cook-off!

response.speaker: Brook
response.text: Suits me! If you can't beat my cooking, it'll show that Draff was clearly wrong about you.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Alright — but if I win, you have to use my winning dish to promote Springvale!

response.speaker: Brook
response.text: And if you lose, you have to add my winning dish to the Wanmin menu!

response.speaker: Brook
response.text: With a caption saying "This special addition to the Wanmin menu is generously provided by Chef Brook of Springvale, meat expert." Hmph!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: You have a deal!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: I'm off to get ingredients — I will see you all in Liyue!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait! Waaait!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, let's try and catch up.

choices.text: I guess this is a sort of culinary clash of the titans.
